title: loq
description: modpack with QOL and optimisation features.
body:
# LOQ

[![](https://img.shields.io/discord/1525357108541919362?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white&label=Join%20Server)](https://discord.gg/zD2jUXsRDD)

## About

Lightweight modpack aimed towards quality-of-life and optimisation for Fabric, designed in increasing FPS and lowering input delay while creating an optimal PVP and/or multiplayer experience


## Config
* Disable low armour durability SFX in 'uku's armor HUD'
* Enable Always On Shulker box preview in 'Shulker Box Tooltip'
* Libraries Not Counted in 'Mod Menu'
* Button in options disabled in 'ukulib'
* Tutorial disabled in 'BetterHitReg'
  
Client-side only. Requires Fabric Loader and Java 21+.

Latest available versions: [26.2](https://modrinth.com/modpack/loq/version/26.2+1.0.0), [1.21.11](https://modrinth.com/modpack/loq/version/1.21.11+1.16)

Contact through our [Discord](discord.gg/zD2jUXsRDD) if you have any suggestions or issues
